programme.title: Africa Express
programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship In the seventh episode, the race moves to Kenya, where the participants face new challenges.First, they must memorize and recreate the national symbols of the African country, which gives them the chance to enter the Watamu facility and confront snakes while cleaning the terrariums.Then it's time for an exciting amulet game on the picturesque Love Island beach.Tension mounts as couples decide to draw prizes and punishments in envelopes - each of which can bring both benefits and unexpected difficulties.The competition ends with demanding tasks in the cashew cooperative and a surprising finale in the fort in Mombasa, where participants will have to face a false checkpoint and fight to reach the finish line.
